newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL REAL SLIPS 0.08 PCT ON LOWER MINI-BAND.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL REAL SLIPS 0.08 PCT ON LOWER MINI-BAND.

text.p: Brazil's real fell 0.08 percent to close at 1.0851 per dollar on Thursday after the central bank lowered the mini-band on the currency for the second time this month, dealers said.
The central bank lowered the mini-band by buying dollars at 1.0850 reais and selling at 1.0900 reais in the commercial foreign exchange market.
The previous mini-band was set at between 1.0840 and 1.0890 reais per dollar.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed up 0.03 percent at 1.0903 per dollar, while in the parallel market the real currency was flat at 1.135 per dollar.
